requested_by: Spring port P0: RELR and class-metadata size levers (local_8b7074aa), for ADR-031
summary: Start-up of bench-rest before (440d72d^) and after (440d72d) the TLS-only OpenSSL build: exec to the first correct GET /json, interleaved
why: ADR-031 builds OpenSSL for TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only (tools/native_build.py OPENSSL_TLS_ONLY), saving 899,216 bytes on bench-rest. Each side rebuilds its own native prefix in its worktree, and configuration.h is checked, so the two sides cannot link the same libcrypto. bench-rest serves plain HTTP: OpenSSL is linked but not exercised, so both timings are regression checks, expected neutral. No TLS throughput workload is requested; one would need its own reviewed workload and Go comparator.
note: The requester asked to check that configuration.h defines OPENSSL_NO_DES and OPENSSL_NO_LEGACY after and neither before. OpenSSL's no-legacy emits no OPENSSL_NO_LEGACY macro, so the check reads Configure's own record, configdata.pm %disabled: after disables legacy, des, rc4 and tls1; before disables none of them.
